settings.heading: Ingredients
settings.content:
• EDI-purified water – pure water base
  • Phenoxyethanol – preserves formula freshness
  • Chlorhexidine – antibacterial effect
  • Decyl glucoside – gentle plant-derived cleanser
  • Jojoba oil – conditions and softens coat
  • Honey extract – soothes and moisturises skin
  • Shea butter extract – nourishes dry or flaky skin
  • Corn extract – gentle skin conditioning

✔️ Fragrance-free ✔️ Not tested on animals (cruelty-free) ✔️ Free from alcohol and harsh chemicals

settings.heading: How to Use
settings.content:
• Slip the glove over your hand until it sits snug
  • Wipe head to tail, along the coat, legs and paws
  • Pay extra attention to muddy or smelly areas
  • Use daily after walks for best results — takes under 60 seconds

settings.heading: Will my dog tolerate it?
settings.row_content: Almost every dog do — far better than baths. No water, no tub, no restraint. Your hand inside the glove means your dog feels your touch, not a tool.

settings.heading: Is this a replacement for bathing?
settings.row_content: No — it's what keeps your dog clean between baths so they become less urgent and less frequent.

settings.heading: When will I see results?
settings.row_content: Most owners notice a fresher coat within the first few uses. Visible improvement in coat condition within 1–2 weeks of daily use.

settings.heading: Can I use it on my cat?
settings.row_content: GloveWipes is formulated for dogs. We'd recommend checking with your vet before use on cats.

settings.heading: How do I use it?
settings.row_content: Slip the glove over your hand, textured side out. Wipe head to tail, paws, and any problem areas. Done in under 60 seconds.

settings.heading: How should I store them?
settings.row_content: Store at room temperature, away from direct sunlight. Keep the lid closed after each use to maintain moisture and freshness.
